title: Explicit super-square-root-exponential depth-three circuits
exact_target: Is there a language in deterministic polynomial time whose n-variable membership functions require depth-three OR–AND–OR Boolean circuits of size $>2^{A\surd n}$ for every fixed $A>0$ and every sufficiently large n, with unrestricted bottom fan-in and no circuit uniformity condition?
